the magnetic order is most stable when its direction is closest to the direction of the applied pressure.

The main takeaway from our work is that
uniaxial strain can be used to tune the phase diagram of MnSi and that the phase diagram can be mapped out by applying uniaxial strains to the sample.
the Skyrmion phase is suppressed by uniaxial stress parallel to the magnetic field and enhanced by uniaxual stress perpendicular to the magnetic fields.
the SLP is the magnetic phase that is most sensitive to the uniaxial strain, whereas the conical phase and the helical order phase are less sensitive to strain.
